full_prompt_en: The image is a square, high-contrast black-and-white documentary-style photograph of a line of people moving through tall grass under immense, dark billowing clouds. The upper half of the frame is filled by cloud masses, with pale mist and charcoal shadow folded into one another across the sky. A bright white opening beneath those clouds separates the people from the heavy ceiling above them. The line begins as small overlapping figures near the left middle distance and advances diagonally toward the right foreground. Along the lower left, tall seed heads and grasses blur into pale streaks, partly hiding the legs and lower bodies. The nearer people wear dark practical layers and carry bulky shapes across their shoulders and backs, though the exact contents are indistinct in the grain and shadow. Near the center, a figure in a cap stands out through a pale cheek and a darker jacket, facing toward the right. At the front on the right, a larger figure has dark hair and a face turned ahead; the shoulders and chest are almost black against the luminous air behind. Another dark figure is cropped by the far right edge, extending the procession beyond the frame. The people do not pose for the camera; their repeated forward lean and close spacing create the sense of a group continuing through difficult ground. Black areas have substantial weight, yet facial highlights and the pale grass preserve enough detail to distinguish the foremost forms. Diffuse light arrives from the bright opening behind the line, edging heads and shoulders while leaving faces and clothing in deep shade. Coarse photographic grain, softened movement, and the feathered boundary of the clouds make the scene rough and immediate rather than polished. The overall composition sets a narrow diagonal human procession against a towering atmospheric mass, with stark tonal contrast and a tense, determined mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、高反差的黑白纪实感照片：一队人从高草中前进，头顶是巨大翻涌的深色云团。画面上半部被云块占满，浅色雾气与炭黑阴影在天空中相互卷叠。云层下方一道明亮白色空隙把人群与沉重的上方空间分隔开。队伍从左侧中景里较小且相互遮挡的人影开始，斜向右侧前景推进。左下方，高高的草穗模糊成浅色条纹，局部遮住腿和下半身。近处的人穿深色实用衣装，肩背上带着鼓起的形体，但颗粒与阴影使其具体内容难辨。中央附近，一名戴帽的人物以浅色面颊和较深的外衣从人群中显出，朝向右方。右侧前端，更大的人物有深发，面孔望向前方；肩胸在背后明亮空气前近乎漆黑。另一个深色身影被最右边缘截断，使队伍仿佛继续延伸到画外。人们没有面向镜头摆姿势；重复的前倾动作与紧密间距传达出集体穿越艰难地面的感觉。黑色区域重量很大，脸部亮点和浅色草丛却仍保留足够细节，让最近的人物可辨。漫射光从队伍身后的明亮空隙照来，为头肩勾出边缘，而面孔与衣装留在深影中。粗颗粒、轻微的运动柔化与云团羽化的边界让场景粗粝而即时，并不精修。整体构图以窄窄的斜向人群对照高耸的大气团块，明暗强烈，情绪紧张而坚定。
style_prompt_en: A grainy, high-contrast monochrome photographic treatment organizes the frame through broad masses of near-black, silver gray, and bright white. Diffuse backlight separates overlapping dark forms with slim highlights while allowing much of their interior detail to fall into shadow. Tonal transitions are rugged and irregular: soft atmospheric edges meet more decisive silhouettes, and coarse grain remains visible in both light and dark passages. A diagonal progression supplies motion beneath a much larger upper field, making small repeated shapes feel pressed by surrounding scale. Foreground texture can blur into pale streaks, while the central forms retain enough contour to remain readable. The composition gains depth from successive overlaps rather than clean color separation. Its overall effect is stark, immersive, and physically immediate, with the brightest interval sharpening the tension between dense darkness and airy space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种粗颗粒、高反差的黑白摄影处理通过近黑、银灰与亮白的大片明暗组织画面。漫射逆光以细窄亮边分开相互重叠的深色形体，同时让其内部许多细节沉入阴影。调子过渡粗粝而不规则：柔软的大气边缘与较明确的剪影相遇，明暗区域都保留可见颗粒。斜向推进的节奏在更庞大的上部色域下提供运动感，使重复的小形体仿佛受到周围尺度的挤压。前景纹理可模糊成浅色条纹，中央形体仍保留足够轮廓供辨认。纵深来自连续的前后遮挡，而非干净的色彩分界。整体效果冷峻、沉浸且带有身体般的即时感，最亮的一道间隙强化了密集黑暗与通透空间之间的紧张关系。
theme_en: A line of people moving through tall grass beneath immense dark clouds
theme_zh: 一队人穿行高草，头顶压着巨大的深色云团
name: Sebastiao Salgado
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
